name: Archangels
overview: The Scriptures reveal that archangels are powerful heavenly beings who serve God and assist in spiritual battles, as seen in Daniel where Michael is described as one of the chief princes who aids in overcoming opposition. Gabriel, another prominent angel, stands in the presence of God and delivers important messages, exemplifying the role of archangels as messengers of divine truth. Angels watch over God's people and continually worship Him, underscoring their role in both protection and praise. Believers are called to rely on the Lord’s strength and might, recognizing that these heavenly beings operate under His sovereign authority.
